primer: Standard Ethereum JSON-RPC. Numeric quantities are HEX (0x-prefixed). Logs are raw: topics[] + data (ERC-20 Transfer = topic0 0xddf2..., topic1=from, topic2=to, data=value).

questions.prompt: How many transaction receipts are in this block?
What is the total number of event logs across all receipts in this block?
How many transactions in this block failed (status 0)?
